name: An open stay whose EES record ends earlier is an exit disagreement, not a missing entry

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-06-20&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-06-20 and clears saved trips)

Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry date 2026-06-01 (data-testid=trip-entry), tick 'still in the Schengen area' (data-testid=trip-open) and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Enter 10 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and type exactly '2026-06-01 2026-06-10' in the EES records box (data-testid=ees-records)
Among the result codes (data-testid=ees-code, read the data-code attributes) there is 'exit-dates-disagree' and there is no 'likely-missing-entry'
